description.en: The seated frog carries the lower-left weight. Six colorful musical shapes lead the eye into the upper-right space.
description.zh: 蹲坐的小青蛙稳住左下方的重心，六个彩色音符把视线带向右上方的留白。

title.zh: 平面的色块，连贯的轮廓

description.en: Broad planes clarify the face and belly. Smaller polygons describe the eyes, open mouth, and familiar little toes.
description.zh: 脸和肚子由大块平面构成，眼睛、张开的嘴巴和脚趾用更细的多边形刻画，保留熟悉的表情。

description.en: Deeper sage, visible tonal curves, fine grain, and soft shadows give the green character a matte paper setting.
description.zh: 加深的鼠尾草绿、清晰的同色弧线、细微颗粒与柔和阴影，为绿色角色增添哑光纸面的层次。

sizeNote.en: At 16 px the green silhouette and open mouth lead; individual facets and musical notes merge into small color accents.
sizeNote.zh: 缩到 16 px 时，绿色轮廓和张开的嘴巴承担辨识度，细碎的切面与音符会合并成小小的色彩点缀。

goal.zh: 通过网页编程助手处理本地项目，把对话、工具执行、MCP 工具和可续接会话放在一起。

description.en: Unequal lily-leaf arcs meet three listening ripples, echoing the frog and its musical notes.
description.zh: 大小不一的睡莲弧线与三道声波相遇，呼应青蛙身旁的彩色音符。

alt.en: Full-body green frog with musical notes on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: Frogie，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Full-body green frog with musical notes.
description.zh: 全身入镜的绿色青蛙，身旁跃动着彩色音符。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥62px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 62px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
